In addition to team specific tasks, I remedied reported security vulnerabilities and resolved accessibility issues.

positions.title: Job Spidering Group Lead
positions.description: In 2013, I was promoted to the role of Group Lead for Job Spidering. In this space, I directed two teams with 20 reports, upheld company data expectations, and defined department goals. My responsibilities ran a wide gamut from managerial and hiring tasks through more technical application management. I administered the Kofax Kapow enterprise application, developed and updated internal Windows applications, and monitored Kapow/remote servers for daily performance. In 2014 I received the 'Rising Star' award for outstanding growth potential within the organization.
positions.insights: Troubleshooting, Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and +10 skills

positions.title: Job Spider Team Lead
positions.description:
My time as a team lead was comprised of two distinct roles. I was promoted from Programmer to Team Lead in May 2011. 

Team Lead - Development, May 2011 – May 2012
Oversaw the work of 10+ programmers in a team with high rate of turnover due to promotions. The formal training program I created was used in training over a dozen developers in rapid succession. Simultaneously, I crafted and shared resolutions to complex programming issues that effected the team. Implemented standard procedures for code reviews. 

Team Lead - Data Quality,  May 2012 – July 2013 
In May 2012, I began supervising the Spider Data Quality team. Data quality was upheld proactively and re-actively. Reviewers' workflow was improved through effective documentation updates and supplemental information. The rate of critical errors returned by programmers drastically dropped after designing requirements for internal tools to handle file checking automatically.
